name: oma
description: OMA — One Man Army. A phase-gated SDLC team of specialist agents for Claude Code. Validated on Next.js + TypeScript + Prisma.

plugins.name: oma
plugins.description: Give it a project idea; it runs Discovery → Architecture → Design → Build → QA → DevOps → Growth with role-specialized agents, stopping at a gate after every phase for your approval. Produces a working repository plus the PRD, API contract, design system, runnable HTML mockups, tests and launch material a real team would have written. Built and validated for Next.js + TypeScript + Prisma — other stacks are supported by design but have not been tested.
